description: Synthetic-data methodological test: can standard cluster-validation indices distinguish a genuine 4-subtype mixture (A) from a single 6-dimensional continuum (B)? Not real diabetes data.
interpretation: Silhouette (best k=2 in both; never selects true k=4) and gap statistic (best k=7 in both) FAIL to distinguish discrete from continuum and return apparent clusters from a pure continuum. Only finite-mixture BIC separates them: n=4 for the true mixture, n=1 for the continuum. 1D bimodality coefficient is underpowered (<0.555 in both). Conclusion: silhouette/bootstrap-stability at fixed k cannot establish discreteness; model-based mixture selection or multivariate multimodality tests are required.
